name: curio-robot
description: Voice-powered AI assistant with 30+ response cards, wake word detection, and smart home control
author: Curio contributors

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:worker && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build -- --base ./ && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build -- --base ./ && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build -- --base ./ && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build -- --base ./ && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.electron:build:all: npm run build -- --base ./ && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --mac --linux --publish never
scripts.rpi:deploy: npm run build && echo 'Now run: scp -r dist/ pi@curio.local:/tmp/curio-dist/ && ssh pi@curio.local sudo /opt/curio/update.sh /tmp/curio-dist'
